text: The unicode.org UDHR project (the second of GAP-202's two named sources) is fully decommissioned, not merely access-restricted: the index page states hosting has moved to OHCHR/UN, and every former data-file path (per-language .txt, the udhr_txt.zip bulk archive, and the unaccented variant) 404s.
quote: The Unicode Consortium is no longer hosting the UDHR in Unicode project.

text: The DFRWS 2007 file-carving challenge extended DFRWS 2006 with more file types and more complex fragmentation scenarios; its winning approach built format-specific fragment validators (including one for PDF) grounded in a theory of file mapping and fragmentation, which is directly relevant to a classic-file-carving damage class the P1 hidden-recall check flagged as under-covered (3 of 4 missed).

enssec/squashfs_bitflip_repair's README claims an Apache-family license but the repository's LICENSE file is not present at the expected path (404), so the exact license terms behind the NAND bit-flip-rate cross-check (SRC-0126/CLM-0341) code could not be independently confirmed in this session.

peepdf-3 (a maintained fork of peepdf) is GPL-3.0-only, confirmed from the COPYING file bundled in its pip package. It may be invoked as an external CLI tool for structural PDF inspection, but per the clean-room rule its source must never be read into or pasted into PDFPundit's own codebase.

dfxml_python is not published on PyPI under 'dfxml' or 'dfxml-python' (both 404); it installs from its GitHub source and is dual CC0-1.0/LGPL-3.0-licensed as a US-government (NPS/NIST) work, which is permissive enough to depend on directly for a provenance record without a clean-room concern.
quote: This software is a work of the Naval Postgraduate School (NPS) and the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST).

text: RUB-NDS's pdf-attacker repository (default branch master) carries no LICENSE file, so by default the code is all-rights-reserved; its attack templates can inform DMG-009's design by description/citation but the code itself must not be vendored.

Direct WARC range-fetches to data.commoncrawl.org, the same access pattern OBS-0201 used successfully in an earlier session, returned HTTP 403 Forbidden in this session (2026-09-27) with no proxy-level connection failure recorded, meaning the block (if any) is at Common Crawl's origin, not the container's proxy. This puts GAP-100's plan to scale the natural-pairs sampler to thousands of pairs at risk until reachability is reconfirmed on a future date.
